info.name: Dorra Alaseel - Complete API v1 Collection
info.description: Complete API v1 endpoints for Dorra Alaseel Car Rental System - All /api/v1/ routes

request.description: Preview the cost and new return date for a rental extension without committing any changes. Booking must be in ONGOING status.
Extend an ONGOING rental. Extension cost is collected on car return. Requires booking_id (ongoing booking owned by user) and extension_days (1–90).
Retrieve the full extension history for a specific booking, including extension count, total extension days, current return date, and per-extension cost breakdown.
Cancel a pending (status=0) or booked (status=1) booking. Balance paid bookings are automatically refunded to the user's wallet.
Get all available cars with filtering and sorting
Get car models, optionally filtered by car type
Get all cars from a specific vendor
Get details of a specific car
Send OTP code via SMS to the provided phone number
Send OTP code via WhatsApp to the provided phone number
Verify the OTP code sent to the phone number
Twilio webhook for message status updates
